item.title: Yolo County Fair — Fri Aug 7, 5:00 PM — Yolo County Fairgrounds
item.description: Yolo County Fair August 7th-9th & August 12th-16th The Yolo County Fair, California’s longest-running free-gate fair, returns in 2026 with more days, more entertainment and more opportunities for families to celebrate the region’s agricultural heritage. For the first time in its history, the Fair will span eight days over two weekends. An Outdoor Kickoff Weekend will run Friday, Aug. 7 through Sunday, Aug. 9, followed by the traditional Fair Wednesday, Aug. 12 through Sunday, Aug. 16. Admission to the Fair, themed “Hog August Nights this year,” remains free. The new opening weekend will feature headline arena concerts by country music stars Hunter Hayes and Chris Lane, corgi racing, livestock shows, a carnival midway, silent discos and live entertainment on multiple stages. The traditional five-day Fair will bring the opening of the full Fair experience, including indoor exhibits, community competitions, youth livestock events, racing pigs, Kids Day, Senior and Special Friends Day,

item.title: Princess Ida — Fri Aug 7, 7:00 PM — 24th Street Theater
item.description:
Princess Ida, desperate to escape the patriarchal society she has been raised in, breaks her engagement with Hilarion, the prince her father selected for her when she was a baby, to found Castle Adamant, a women’s university. Prince Hilarion, accompanied by his friends, Cyril and Florian, sneaks into Castle Adamant, attempting to woo the princess. Calamity, hilarity, and a battle between rival kingdoms ensues – but will Princess Ida find love after all? This modern adaptation of Gilbert & Sullivan’s PRINCESS IDA boasts a beautiful score, catchy lyrics, and one of comic opera’s most interesting heroines. A LOTS company premiere!
Source: The Dirt

item.title: Grease the Musical — Fri Aug 7, 7:30 PM — Woodland Opera House
item.description: Leather jackets and poodle skirts are taking over the Woodland Opera House stage this August as The Woodland Wellness Collective presents Grease. Set in 1959 at Rydell High, Grease follows the duck-tailed, hot-rodding Burger Palace Boys and the gum-snapping Pink Ladies as they navigate friendship, first love, peer pressure, and growing up. After a whirlwind summer romance, Danny Zuko and Sandy Dumbrowski unexpectedly reunite at school, where Danny must choose between his tough-guy image and his true feelings. Packed with unforgettable characters, energetic dance numbers, and a rock ‘n’ roll score that has captivated audiences for decades, Grease remains a timeless celebration of youth and self-discovery. item.title: Hattie Craven Live — Fri Aug 7, 7:30 PM — The Melon Ball – Watermelon Music
item.description: Hattie Craven is a genre-blending singer, multi-instrumentalist, and magnetic performer who has been onstage since early childhood. Raised in a deeply musical household and mentored by her father, award-winning artist and educator Joe Craven, she made her festival debut at just four years old on the Kate Wolf Music Festival main stage alongside Laura Love. A natural actor, dancer, and vocalist, Hattie grew from early musical-theater leads into a sought-after session singer by age eleven, recording her debut album “Eleven” with the Joe Craven Trio. She has since released multiple solo albums—including Bright—and continues to evolve her sound across folk, bluegrass, jazz, pop, and soul. Her dynamic live presence has earned her standing ovations at major festivals including Strawberry, California World Fest, Wintergrass, Live Oak, Parkfield Bluegrass, Millpond, Suwannee Roots Revival, and Delfest. item.description: AXIS GALLERY 21st ANNUAL NATIONAL JURIED COMPETITION August 7–30, 2026 Second Saturday Reception August 8, 2026, 5–8 PM Axis Gallery presents the 21st Annual National Juried Competition, a group exhibition featuring works selected by juror Sharon Butler, founder of Two Coats of Paint. The exhibition includes works by artists from around the country in a variety of mediums.
